title: Sommelier: Open-Source Audio Processing Pipeline
summary: An open-source modular pipeline designed to transform raw conversational audio into high-quality training data for Full-duplex Speech Language Models. It integrates speaker diarization, ASR Mixture of Experts, and background noise removal to preserve natural dialogue dynamics.
research_notes: Developed by KAIST AI and NAVER Cloud; features a Mixture of Experts ASR ensemble using Whisper, Parakeet, and Canary models.

evolution.summary: The project remains the primary open-source framework for processing 'in-the-wild' conversational audio; it is extensively used to generate datasets for full-duplex conversational models like Moshi.
